name: AI Anime Pro
tagline: AI Anime Pro is an AI-powered creative platform for generating polished anime and manga-inspired visuals
description: AI Anime Pro is an AI-powered creative platform for generating polished anime and manga-inspired visuals. Users can turn text prompts into anime characters, avatars, waifu art, fantasy scenes, cyberpunk concepts, manga panels, and social-ready illustrations. The platform also supports photo-to-anime conversion, reference-guided generation, multiple aspect ratios, style presets, manga translation, and background removal.
